title: How TikTok Became a Matter of National Security

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着 300 件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听奥德马斯·皮格特出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: TikTok is one of the most popular apps in the country, used by one out of every three Americans.
sentences.zh: TikTok 是美国最受欢迎的应用程序之一，每三个美国人中就有一个人在使用。

sentences.en: In recent weeks, the Biden administration has threatened to ban it.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，拜登政府威胁要封禁它。

sentences.en: Today, Sapna Maheshwari on how an app known for videos of lip-syncing, dancing and bread-baking is now seen by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，萨普娜·马赫什瓦里将讲述这款以对口型、跳舞和烘焙视频而闻名的应用，是如何被美国

sentences.en: government as a threat to national security.
sentences.zh: 政府视为国家安全威胁的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 3 月 20 日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Sapna, you're a business reporter for The Times and you cover TikTok, which is, of course, an extremely popular app that lots of people are using.
sentences.zh: 那么，萨普娜，你是《时报》的商业记者，负责报道 TikTok，这当然是一款很多人都在使用的极其流行的应用。

sentences.en: And for many months now, it has been surrounded by lots of controversy.
sentences.zh: 而且在过去的几个月里，它一直被各种争议所包围。

sentences.en: And I want you to tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 我想请你跟我聊聊这些情况。

sentences.en: Tell me what's happening.
sentences.zh: 告诉我发生了什么。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, TikTok is, of course, a super popular app.
sentences.zh: 所以，TikTok 当然是一款超级流行的应用。

sentences.en: It's full of short-form videos.
sentences.zh: 它充满了短视频。

sentences.en: Teens love it.
sentences.zh: 青少年们很喜欢它。

sentences.en: They're on it all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都在刷它。

sentences.en: But TikTok, while it appears on your phone with apps like Instagram and Snapchat and Twitter,
sentences.zh: 但是，虽然 TikTok 出现在你的手机上，和 Instagram、Snapchat 以及 Twitter 这些应用并列，

sentences.en: stands apart from these companies because it's owned by a Chinese company called ByteDance.
sentences.zh: 它却与这些公司截然不同，因为它是由一家名为字节跳动的中国公司所拥有的。

sentences.en: And that ownership has increasingly been raising skepticism and alarm bells with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这种所有权关系正日益引起美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府的怀疑和警惕。

sentences.en: And just recently, the Biden administration reportedly told TikTok that it wants the company's Chinese ownership to sell TikTok or face a possible ban in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，据报道拜登政府告诉 TikTok，要求其中国所有者出售 TikTok，否则将面临在美国被封禁的可能。

sentences.en: So, a ban seems like a pretty drastic thing, Sapna.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨普娜，封禁听起来是一件相当激进的事情。

sentences.en: Like, what is the fear here?
sentences.zh: 大家在担心什么呢？

sentences.en: What's the government saying?
sentences.zh: 政府是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So, basically, for a long time now, the government has been worried about national security concerns tied to TikTok.
sentences.zh: 基本上，长期以来，政府一直对与 TikTok 相关的国家安全问题感到担忧。

sentences.en: And when you look at TikTok and you look at what teens are watching, that may sound crazy on the face of it.
sentences.zh: 当你审视 TikTok 并观察青少年们在看什么时，表面上听起来可能很疯狂。

sentences.en: But because of the company's Chinese ownership, U.S.
sentences.zh: 但由于该公司是中国所有，美国

sentences.en: officials have said that there is a chance that TikTok could be used by the Chinese government to collect information on Americans or influence them through TikTok's content.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示，TikTok 有可能被中国政府利用，来收集美国人的信息，或者通过 TikTok 的内容对他们施加影响。

sentences.en: And this moment is really pivotal because the Biden administration is saying, hey, this is a huge risk and we're doing something about it.
sentences.zh: 而现在这个时刻非常关键，因为拜登政府在说：嘿，这是一个巨大的风险，我们正在采取行动。

sentences.en: So, Sapna, how did we get here?
sentences.zh: 那么，萨普娜，我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: I mean, how did a Chinese company create one of the most beloved apps in America?
sentences.zh: 我是说，一家中国公司是怎么创造出美国最受欢迎的应用之一的？

sentences.en: So, we have to start with the company that owns TikTok, ByteDance, with a Y.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们得从拥有 TikTok 的公司——字节跳动（ByteDance）说起，拼写是 B-Y-T-E。

sentences.en: It's a company that makes apps and it was founded in 2012 by a Chinese entrepreneur named Zhang Yiming.
sentences.zh: 这是一家制作应用程序的公司，由中国企业家张一鸣于 2012 年创立。

sentences.en: This was a young man who was very much inspired by companies like Amazon, by people like Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 这是一个深受亚马逊等公司和马克·扎克伯格等人激励的年轻人。

sentences.en: And he was looking at the contributions these people had made and was thinking, you know, I want to make something like that, but from China.
sentences.zh: 他看着这些人所做出的贡献，心想：你知道吗，我也想做出类似的东西，但要从中国出发。

sentences.en: I'm going to make something that's global, that transcends our borders and put China on the map.
sentences.zh: 我要做出全球化的产品，超越我们的国界，让中国在世界版图上占有一席之地。

sentences.en: So, he wants to create products that everyone around the world would use.
sentences.zh: 所以，他想创造出全世界每个人都会使用的产品。

sentences.en: Like, be the Chinese Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.zh: 就像是成为中国的马克·扎克伯格。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是这样。

sentences.en: And what's really interesting is he carried that dream into the ByteDance corporate culture.
sentences.zh: 真正有趣的是，他把这个梦想带入了字节跳动的企业文化中。

sentences.en: He would quote tech icons like Steve Jobs.
sentences.zh: 他会引用史蒂夫·乔布斯等科技偶像的话。

sentences.en: And he was known for putting this motto on the walls that said, always day one.
sentences.zh: 而且他以在墙上贴出“始终是第一天”（Always Day One）的座右铭而闻名。

sentences.en: It was a motivational phrase that was taken directly from Amazon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个直接取自亚马逊的励志短语。

sentences.en: And you could see, you know, where his aspirations were going.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出，你知道的，他的抱负所在。

sentences.en: So, Sapna, how did he go about trying to achieve that dream?
sentences.zh: 那么，萨普娜，他是如何着手实现那个梦想的？

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: So, ByteDance starts out making popular apps in China, but everything really picks up a few years later when he notices a breakout app in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 字节跳动起初在中国制作流行的应用程序，但几年后，当他注意到美国有一款爆发式的应用时，一切才真正起飞。

sentences.en: called Musical.ly.
sentences.zh: called Musical.ly.

sentences.en: It was best known as an app where you could make short videos with music, and it had this cult following with American teenagers.
sentences.zh: 它最出名的是一款可以制作带音乐短视频的应用，在美国青少年中拥有狂热的追随者。

sentences.en: He took a real interest in this, saw how it was resonating with young people, and after trying to imitate it a bit, he goes on to try and acquire it, which he does.
sentences.zh: 他对此产生了浓厚的兴趣，看到了它如何与年轻人产生共鸣，在尝试模仿了一阵子后，他决定收购它，他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: So, he buys Musical.ly in 2017 and then repackages it into a new app called TikTok, and then he launches it in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，他在 2017 年收购了 Musical.ly，然后将其重新包装成一款名为 TikTok 的新应用，并在美国发布。

sentences.en: And that's kind of his stepping stone into an American audience.
sentences.zh: 这就是他进入美国市场的敲门砖。

sentences.en: Okay, so he gets this foothold into the American market through this other app, Musical.ly.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以他是通过另一款应用 Musical.ly 在美国市场站稳了脚跟。

sentences.en: But there's a lot of apps out there, right?
sentences.zh: 但市面上有很多应用，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, what does he do to make this one breakthrough?
sentences.zh: 他是怎么让这一款取得突破的？

sentences.en: There's all these different things that make TikTok so accessible.
sentences.zh: 有各种各样的因素让 TikTok 变得如此易用。

sentences.en: People are really able to just take out their phone and start filming.
sentences.zh: 人们真的可以随时拿出手机开始拍摄。

sentences.en: You can do things like reaction videos.
sentences.zh: 你可以做反应视频之类的东西。

sentences.en: You can apply different clips of music or sounds to your videos, and then other users can remix them.
sentences.zh: 你可以给视频添加不同的音乐片段或声音，然后其他用户可以对它们进行混剪。

sentences.en: And TikTok is less about connecting with your family and friends and more about getting you to watch all these short videos.
sentences.zh: TikTok 不太关注与家人朋友的联系，更多的是让你观看所有这些短视频。

sentences.en: And it really sought to be more like television, less of a sort of traditional social media app.
sentences.zh: 它确实试图变得更像电视，而不是那种传统的社交媒体应用。

sentences.en: When you open the app, you're immediately served this unending stream of really short videos.
sentences.zh: 当你打开应用时，你立刻就会看到源源不断的短视频流。

sentences.en: And very quickly, the app starts paying attention to what you do next.
sentences.zh: 而且很快，应用就开始关注你的下一步动作。

sentences.en: It looks at how long you watch that video, what second you switch away from it.
sentences.zh: 它会观察你观看视频的时长，你在哪一秒切换掉它。

sentences.en: If you comment on that video, if you send it to a friend, it's keeping track of all of that information.
sentences.zh: 如果你评论了那个视频，或者把它发给朋友，它都会追踪所有这些信息。

sentences.en: And it's using that to quickly tailor the next video you see and the next and the next after that.
sentences.zh: 并利用这些信息快速为你定制下一个视频，以及再下一个，再下一个。

sentences.en: And its algorithm is excellent at figuring out what you liked and serving you more of that.
sentences.zh: 它的算法非常擅长找出你喜欢什么，并为你提供更多类似的内容。

sentences.en: Okay, so its special sauce is its algorithm and the fact that it's serving up these short, very tailored to my taste videos,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以它的秘诀在于算法，以及它提供这些短小、非常符合我口味的视频，

sentences.en: like potato chips that people are just eating and eating and eating.
sentences.zh: 就像薯片一样，人们不停地吃啊吃啊吃。

sentences.en: So what happens out there in the world when people start using it?
sentences.zh: 那么当人们开始使用它时，世界上发生了什么？

sentences.en: So TikTok starts picking up a following, people seem to really like the app, but the real game changer comes in 2020, when, as we all know, the pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: TikTok 开始积累粉丝，人们似乎真的很喜欢这个应用，但真正的转折点出现在 2020 年，正如我们所知，疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: And it just blows up.
sentences.zh: 然后它就彻底火了。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm bored in a house and I'm in a house, bored.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我在家里很无聊，我在家里，很无聊。

sentences.zh: 在家里很无聊，我在家里，很无聊。

sentences.zh: 人们转向 TikTok 寻求娱乐，并发现制作视频是多么容易。

sentences.en: So I have a decent amount of experience making bread in high school, I actually had.
sentences.zh: 所以我高中时有相当丰富的做面包经验，我其实有。

sentences.zh: 他们在上面进行所有的隔离活动。

sentences.zh: 但他们也在做一些更古怪的事情，这些事情开始成为潮流。

sentences.zh: 这是一种非常奇幻的田园美学，让你看起来就像刚从森林里的小屋走出来一样。

sentences.en: And you spend your time wearing flowy dresses and making flower crowns.
sentences.zh: 你花时间穿着飘逸的裙子，制作花环。

sentences.en: The one good thing about this quarantine is that my wardrobe can now consist completely of my vintage nightgowns.
sentences.zh: 这次隔离唯一的好处就是我的衣柜现在完全可以由我的复古睡裙组成。

sentences.en: And there's also all kinds of dance challenges.
sentences.zh: 还有各种各样的舞蹈挑战。

sentences.en: There's a million examples, but one of them is the savage challenge from Megan Thee Stallion.
sentences.zh: 例子有无数个，其中之一就是梅根·西·斯塔莉安的《Savage》挑战。

sentences.en: And so, it starts really affecting the mainstream culture.

sentences.zh: 她最初是在卧室里制作舞蹈视频。

sentences.zh: 她获得了大量的粉丝。

sentences.en: And a year later, her family has their own Hulu show.
sentences.zh: 一年后，她的家人有了自己的 Hulu 节目。

sentences.en: And then, as TikTok gets more and more users, it starts to wade into the topic of current events.
sentences.zh: 然后，随着 TikTok 获得越来越多的用户，它开始涉足时事话题。

sentences.zh: 如果你一直在关注新闻，你知道唐纳德·特朗普正计划在隔离后举行他的第一场政治集会。

sentences.zh: 然后政府为这次活动做准备。

sentences.en: Which, of course, brings us back to where we started this conversation, right?
sentences.zh: 而且当谈到潜在的出售时，关于它会是什么样子，有太多的问题。

sentences.en: So the Biden administration doesn't seem to be convinced by TikTok's plan.
sentences.zh: TikTok可能极其昂贵。

sentences.en: And now, in a way, it's trying to finish what Trump started, right?
sentences.zh: 美国可能没有多少公司买得起它。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一些买得起的公司，比如谷歌或Facebook，可能会遇到反垄断问题。

sentences.en: But this time around, you have both Republicans and Democrats who are united in this effort against TikTok, which is really different from 2020.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不想接手像TikTok这样的公司，尽管它非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And there's even one interesting new bill that's gaining a lot of traction right now called the Restrict Act that could give more power to the Biden administration to potentially either ban or force a sale of the app.
sentences.zh: 还有一个关于中国会允许什么的问题。

sentences.en: So some people are looking to this as a potential game changer this time around for taking action against TikTok.
sentences.zh: 中国政府可能会出台规定，禁止出口TikTok的算法，即那个使其如此引人入胜且受欢迎的核心技术。

sentences.en: OK, so the Biden administration could have more authority now than the Trump administration had.
sentences.zh: 所以观察事态的发展将非常引人入胜，因为这种局势的走向存在很大的不确定性。

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 那么退一步来看，我的意思是，这让我想到，你知道，

sentences.en: But experts think that the Biden administration is going to run into a lot of the same problems that the Trump administration did.
sentences.zh: 无论你将TikTok视为一个用于跳舞和烘焙面包的健康应用，还是一个安全风险，这实际上取决于你现在如何看待世界。

sentences.en: You already have groups like the ACLU that have come out and said that a ban on TikTok would threaten the First Amendment rights of Americans.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国现在看待世界的方式日益倾向于认为中国是一个威胁。

sentences.en: And then when it comes to a potential sale, there are just so many questions around what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在许多方面，美国采取这种做法似乎是不可避免的，尽管这很奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: TikTok could be incredibly expensive.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个青少年玩乐的应用，而美国政府却在对其施加全部压力。

sentences.en: There may not be that many companies in the United States that could afford it.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: You know, some of the companies that could afford it, like Google or Facebook, might run into antitrust issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为围绕TikTok的这场辩论实际上是美中目前紧张关系的一个晴雨表。

sentences.en: They may not want to take on a company like TikTok, even though it's so popular.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府似乎将TikTok视为一把上了膛的枪。

sentences.en: And there's also the question around, you know, what China will allow.
sentences.zh: 而美国基本上是在说，它不信任这种总部位于中国的科技公司能够不受中国政府的要求或影响。

sentences.en: There could be rules from the Chinese government that prevent the export of TikTok's algorithm, the thing that makes it so compelling and so popular.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: And so it's going to be really fascinating to watch this play out because there's a lot of uncertainty around the shape that this takes.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: So stepping back here for a minute, I mean, it strikes me that, you know,
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: whether you see TikTok as a wholesome app meant for dancing and bread baking or a security risk really depends on how you see the world right now.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: And I think the way that the U.S.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: sees the world right now increasingly is that China is a threat.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: So, you know, in many ways, it seems sort of inevitable that the U.S.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: is taking this approach, even though it's pretty weird, right?
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: Because this is an app where teenagers have fun and the U.S.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: government is bringing down its entire weight on it.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: And I think that this debate around TikTok is really a barometer for the tensions between the U.S.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: and China right now.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: The Biden administration seems to be looking at TikTok as a loaded gun.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: is basically saying that it doesn't trust this kind of technology company that's based in China to remain immune from the demands or influence of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: （注：由于输入编号至149，此处补充缺失的编号对应内容）

sentences.en: And that's a really big deal for relations between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 这对两国关系而言确实是一件大事。

sentences.en: It's interesting because we started this episode with a story of a Chinese entrepreneur, right, who who wanted to create a truly global tech company,
sentences.zh: 这很有意思，因为我们这期节目开头讲的是一位中国企业家的故事，对吧，他想创建一家真正的全球化科技公司，

sentences.en: one that could be as successful in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一家在美国也能像

sentences.en: as it was in China.
sentences.zh: 在中国一样成功的公司。

sentences.en: But if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但如果美国

sentences.en: ends up banning TikTok or forcing the sale of TikTok, what does that say about whether what the founder of this company wanted is even possible at this point?
sentences.zh: 最终封禁TikTok或强制出售TikTok，那么这是否意味着这家公司创始人当初的愿景在当下根本无法实现？

sentences.en: Not just for this company, but for any Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对这家公司，对任何中国公司来说都是如此。

sentences.en: Well, this is definitely challenging, that dream.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实是对那个梦想的挑战。

sentences.en: And it raises a lot of questions around what kinds of social media companies and technology companies can flourish in America in the future.
sentences.zh: 它引发了许多关于未来什么样的社交媒体公司和科技公司能在美国蓬勃发展的问题。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that for years now, China has banned platforms like Facebook or YouTube.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，多年来中国一直封禁Facebook或YouTube等平台。

sentences.en: And a lot of people never thought that that kind of thing would happen in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很多人从未想过这种事情会发生在美国。

sentences.en: But that could be the road that we're going down.
sentences.zh: 但我们可能正在走上那条路。

sentences.en: On Thursday, TikTok CEO Sho Zichu will testify in Congress before the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
sentences.zh: 周四，TikTok首席执行官周受资将在众议院能源和商业委员会作证。

sentences.en: He will face questions about TikTok's ties to China and concerns that it delivers harmful content to young people.
sentences.zh: 他将面临关于TikTok与中国关系，以及它向年轻人传播有害内容等担忧的质询。

sentences.en: The scheduled hearing comes after news outlets, including The New York Times,
sentences.zh: 此次听证会是在包括《纽约时报》在内的多家新闻媒体

sentences.zh: 报道称司法部正在调查字节跳动去年监视记者一事之后召开的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的新闻。

sentences.en: Over the weekend,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，

sentences.en: former President Donald Trump warned his supporters that he could be arrested as soon as tomorrow over a case stemming from the payment of hush money to an adult film star during his 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 前总统唐纳德·特朗普警告支持者，他最早可能于明天被捕，起因是他在2016年竞选期间向一名成人电影明星支付封口费的案件。

sentences.en: In a message posted on the social media platform Truth Social, Trump urged supporters to protest what he described as his impending indictment.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体平台“真实社交”（Truth Social）上发布的一条消息中，特朗普敦促支持者抗议他所称的即将到来的起诉。

sentences.en: But the indictment is not a certainty.
sentences.zh: 但起诉并非板上钉钉。

sentences.en: Prosecutors in the Manhattan District Attorney's Office, which is handling the case, have signaled an indictment could be imminent,
sentences.zh: 负责此案的曼哈顿地区检察官办公室的检察官已暗示起诉可能迫在眉睫，

sentences.en: but have given no precise timetable from when it might come.
sentences.zh: 但并未给出具体的时间表。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that at least a year before the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, the Federal Reserve had warned the bank that its finances appeared risky.
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，在硅谷银行倒闭至少一年前，美联储就曾警告该银行其财务状况看起来存在风险。

sentences.en: Despite those warnings, Silicon Valley Bank did not fix the probleMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些警告，硅谷银行还是没有解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Finally, Credit Suisse, the beleaguered Swiss bank,
sentences.zh: 最后，陷入困境的瑞士信贷银行，

sentences.en: was taken over by a rival bank on Sunday in a hastily arranged deal that was supported by the Swiss government and intended to reassure investors.
sentences.zh: 周日被一家竞争对手银行收购，这是一项在瑞士政府支持下仓促达成的协议，旨在安抚投资者。

sentences.en: UBS agreed to buy Credit Suisse after Switzerland's central bank lent it 100 billion Swiss francs to support the purchase.
sentences.zh: 在瑞士央行提供1000亿瑞士法郎贷款支持收购后，瑞银集团同意收购瑞士信贷。

sentences.en: It was the most consequential fallout to date from the turmoil that spread from the implosion of Silicon Valley Bank.
sentences.zh: 这是硅谷银行倒闭所引发的动荡迄今为止最严重的后果。
